§6.1.1: the five PMK vowels 'split in Labu into i, ê, e, a, o, ô and u in imitation of Bukawa's vowel system', but 'the splits were irregular': PMK *jinji > si 'Cordyline', *rasi- > lasi(nala) 'yr. sister (fs)'. Labu ê, ô are written as in Bukawa (close-mid e, o; e and o are the open-mid vowels).
